readerCopy.body: A future that existed mainly in imagination can become specific enough to start organizing real work around it. When Neptune trines the North Node, imagination and forward movement reinforce each other, supporting creative plans, compassionate work, art, film, music, photography, and other directions that began as a feeling before they had a practical shape. Inspiration gains usefulness once the project has requirements, collaborators, or a next deliverable. The vision does not need to become less imaginative in order to become more actionable.
